story_fr: BXP a signe 68 baux pour 1,1 million de pieds carres au T1 2026, dont 5,5 millions sur l'annee 2025, confirmant un retour solide de la demande pour les bureaux premium.
story_en: BXP signed 68 leases totaling 1.1 million sq ft in Q1 2026, and 5.5 million sq ft across full year 2025, confirming strong demand recovery for premier workplaces.
quote: We commenced the year with strong leasing activity - 68 leases for 1.1M SF in Q1 2026 at a weighted average term of 8.7 years.

story_fr: L'ecart entre taux loue (90,7%) et taux occupe (87,4%) atteint 350 points de base, representant 1,6 million de pieds carres de revenus a commencer en 2026.
story_en: The leased-occupied spread reached 350 bps (90.7% leased vs 87.4% occupied), representing 1.6M sq ft of future revenue expected to commence in 2026.
quote: Our leased-to-occupied spread is 350 basis points, approximately 1.6M SF of signed leases not yet commenced, ~90% expected to start in 2026.

story_fr: BXP releve le point median de sa guidance FFO 2026 a 6,97 dollars par action (fourchette 6,90-7,04), soutenu par la performance du portefeuille et les baux recents.
story_en: BXP raised its 2026 FFO guidance midpoint to $6.97/share (range $6.90-$7.04), supported by portfolio outperformance and recent leasing activity.
quote: We are raising the midpoint of our full year 2026 FFO guidance by $0.01 to $6.97 per share.

story_fr: BXP construit 343 Madison Avenue, tour de 46 etages et 930 000 pieds carres pres de Grand Central, deja pre-louee a 30%, comme moteur de croissance futur a New York.
story_en: BXP is developing 343 Madison Avenue, a 46-story 930,000 sq ft premier workplace adjacent to Grand Central, 30% pre-leased, as a key NYC growth catalyst.
quote: 343 Madison, our 930,000 SF 46-story development adjacent to Grand Central, is in full vertical construction with approximately 30% pre-leased.

story_fr: BXP a genere plus de 1,2 milliard de dollars nets depuis son Investor Day 2025 via des cessions strategiques d'actifs, renforcant la flexibilite du bilan.
story_en: BXP generated over $1.2 billion in net proceeds since its 2025 Investor Day through strategic asset dispositions, strengthening balance sheet flexibility.
quote: Since Investor Day 2025, we have generated over $1.2 billion of net proceeds from asset sales, exceeding our initial target.

story_fr: Au T3 2025, BXP a enregistre 1,22 dollar par action de charges de depreciation non-monetaires liees au programme de cessions, pesant sur le BPA publie.
story_en: In Q3 2025, BXP recorded $1.22/share in non-cash impairment charges related to its asset sales program, weighing on reported EPS.
quote: Q3 2025 EPS impacted by $1.22/share of non-cash impairment charges related to our strategic disposition program.
